name: Giulia Ferretti
headline: Mid-Level UX / Product Designer
summary: Product designer with 5 years of experience crafting user-centered digital experiences for SaaS and e-commerce platforms. Skilled in translating user research insights into scalable design systems and intuitive interfaces. Passionate about collaborative, iterative design processes and cross-functional teamwork with product and engineering teams.

responsibilities: Lead end-to-end design process for a B2B SaaS platform, from research to high-fidelity prototypes
Built and maintained a company-wide design system used across 4 product teams
Conducted user interviews and usability tests to validate design decisions
Collaborated closely with product managers and engineers to ensure design feasibility
Facilitated design critique sessions and mentored junior designers
Designed responsive web and mobile interfaces for e-commerce clients
Conducted user research including surveys and moderated usability testing
Created wireframes, user flows, and interactive prototypes for stakeholder review
Contributed to establishing initial component library for design consistency
Supported senior designers in creating UI mockups and style guides
Assisted with basic user research tasks such as competitor analysis
Produced visual assets and icons for web applications
